name: Otonari-san wa Yuukaihan
source:
＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿

You meet a gentle, older neighbor after moving.
You thought he was a nice guy, but then he suddenly changes.

Enjoy a happy♥ life with Big Brother Yuka!
＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿



You've decided to live alone to attend a university far from home. You've finished moving and will be a university student next month. You were filled with excitement and anxiety, but the guy in the next room seemed like a really nice person, which was a relief! He greeted you with flirty smiles, and you bumped into him when taking out the trash, and you thought things were going to get fun from now on! Or so you thought...!? "Why? Because... I want to become your boyfriend♥"

[NovelGame: https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13994?lang=JA]
translation:
＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿

搬进新家后，你邂逅了一位温柔体贴的年长男邻居。
你原以为他是个大好人，谁知他却突然性情大变。

尽情享受与祐香哥哥在一起的幸福♥生活吧！
＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿



为了就读离老家很远的大学，你决定开始独自租房生活。如今搬家已经顺利结束，下个月起你就是一名正式的大学生了。原本心中交织着期待与不安，好在住在隔壁房间的男人看上去是个不折不扣的大好人，让你一下子松了口气！他总带着撩人的微笑向你打招呼，倒垃圾时也会偶然碰面，让你满心以为接下来的新生活一定会充满乐趣！……你原本是这么以为的！？“问我为什么？因为……我想成为你的男朋友呀♥”
